rules.statement: Sections 658 and 659 of the Civil Procedure Code apply to the investigation of claims to property sequestered after judgment under section 3 of the Crown Debtors Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold, therefore, that sections 658 and 659 apply to the present case."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 658 and 659 of the Civil Procedure Code
